_readme: One entry per outcome the logs report and no metric counts. Set "count" to "counter" (Outcomes.count(name, outcome): a counter name{outcome=...}), "tag" (Outcomes.tag(outcome) on the timer already running; only where _tag says available) or "skip" (a // logast:ignore comment). Edit "name" and "outcome" freely (lower case, dots). Where the line logs a number (_amounts), "amount" names one to count too: "as": "total" (a counter name.<amount> grows by it) or "per-run" (each value one sample of a distribution summary name.<amount>); empty "as" takes metrics.amounts from logast.yaml. Leave "amount" empty to count how often only. Then: logast apply . --auto. `logast metrics . --format json` has the context.
